xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #5805

plan.title: bug(dogfood,ovpr): maintainer must run pinned runtime — close task auto-compile tip bypass

narratives.Description: Ordinary maintainer task verbs must execute the pinned runtime under node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime, matching Git hooks. Tip without a public release requires an explicit staged-runtime materialize into that pin; packages/runtime/dist is not a silent ordinary-verb fallback.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Bound 6326249868: pin-exclusive ordinary invoke (fail-closed missing pin; no packages/runtime/dist fallthrough); demote engine:_ts-build off ordinary verb deps; thin stage-bundle/pack-staged-runtime materialize into checkout node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime; per-checkout replace isolation. Reject Approach B/C and soft tip-dist fallthrough.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer, I want ordinary task verbs to run the same pinned node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime binary that Git hooks already use, so that fast-forward alone cannot silently tip-execute workspace dist.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit tasks/engine.yml and tasks/engine-invoke.cjs so framework-source ordinary invoke selects only node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime/dist/bin.js and fails closed when missing (no packages/runtime/dist fallthrough); cover with tasks/engine-invoke.test.cjs.
2. Remove :engine:_ts-build deps from ordinary verbs across Taskfile.yml and the listed tasks/*.yml files; keep _ts-build only on explicit build/pack/materialize tasks.
3. Add tasks/materialize.yml + tasks/materialize.cjs wrapping packages/runtime/scripts/stage-bundle.mjs and pack-staged-runtime.mjs into this checkout pin with overlay recording, checkout-owned replace, and writer serialization; cover with tasks/materialize.test.cjs.
4. Update content/docs/getting-started.md, launcher.md, and known-limitations.md for FF then optional materialize then tip; add CHANGELOG Unreleased; verify with node --test tasks/engine-invoke.test.cjs tasks/materialize.test.cjs.
